source.pushStatus: local-only; not pushed to the frozen upstream repository

requirements.implementation: Semantic entry, summary, and history regions use a broad history column at wide widths and entry → summary → history source/visual order at narrow widths. The 700px cutoff is a provisional implementation choice.

Existing visible page copy, labels, placeholders, and actions are retained; heading semantics and missing label/input ID associations are corrected. The browser document title now uses the existing product name instead of the scaffold title.
Existing balance and totals calculations remain unchanged; labels and signed transaction amounts remain present, and the summary follows entry on mobile.

The existing delete action is retained with an accessible name, centered decorative SVG, measured 32×32 CSS-pixel target inside its row, subordinate rest, distinct hover/active, and separate 3px focus-visible treatment. The expense edge accent is quieter.
Transaction state/reducer source was not modified. Browser smoke exercised add, totals, row ordering, pointer delete, keyboard reachability, and keyboard delete.
Only brief control-state transitions are used; prefers-reduced-motion reduces them to 0.01ms without removing hover, active, or focus styling. Formal contrast and accessibility audits remain B9 work.

productionBuild.note: The frozen CRA 3.4/Webpack toolchain requires the legacy OpenSSL provider in the current Node environment; no dependency or lockfile was changed.

browserSmoke.coverage: 12 widths from 320px through 1280px were checked for overflow and region geometry with empty state; populated states were exercised/captured at 375px, 768px, and 1280px; add/summary/list behavior, 32x32 target geometry and containment, hover, active, focus-visible, pointer and keyboard deletion, reduced-motion transition duration, visible copy, local font availability, and zero external requests were checked.

knownUncertainties: B9 has not started. This receipt and smoke are not a contract-fidelity, accessibility-conformance, or product-quality pass.
Formal text/control/focus contrast measurements and an accessibility audit remain outstanding.
The responsive overflow sweep used the empty state; B9 should exercise populated content and long descriptions across narrow, intermediate, breakpoint-adjacent, and wide widths.
The mobile keyboard sequence begins at the entry field and reaches delete; inspect the wide-screen spatial relationship of DOM focus order during B9 human review.
The precise colors, type sizes, spacing, radius, column ratio, and 700px breakpoint remain provisional. They are implementation values, not approved design tokens.
A three-way human comparison of frozen control, approved B6 candidate, and B8 implementation remains pending. Pixel equality with the candidate is not a hard requirement.
